notes: Ten capabilities exercised across five unrelated domains (§7.2). The claim under test is NOT 'these prompts read as generic' but 'the same role contract transfers across unrelated domains without domain leakage or routing collapse'. Every cell supplies the inputs the contract requires and nothing more — criteria, preferences and standards are deliberately withheld unless the contract says they must be supplied, so Domain-Guidance dependence is observable.

explore.software: Find out how request retries are implemented in this service and what governs the backoff.
explore.research: Find what evidence exists on whether spaced repetition improves retention beyond six months.
explore.personal: Find out what actually constrains a move from a rented flat to a shared house with a dog.
explore.communication: Find out what this audience of hospital procurement officers already believes about our category.
explore.systems_ops: Find out how traffic reaches the checkout service and what sits between the edge and the pods.

analyze.software: Here are 40 flaky-test records with timings and stack traces. Explain what is driving the flakiness.
analyze.research: Here is a study reporting a 12% effect. Explain how its design and sample constrain what can be concluded.
analyze.personal: Here are three years of household spending records. Explain what is driving the year-on-year increase.
analyze.communication: Here is a keynote transcript. Explain how its argument is constructed and where it depends on unstated premises.
analyze.systems_ops: Here is an incident timeline with metrics. Explain the causal chain from trigger to customer impact.

synthesize.software: Integrate these four design proposals into one coherent picture of the tradeoff space.
synthesize.research: Integrate these six papers into one account of what is established, contested, and unknown.
synthesize.personal: Integrate advice from a financial adviser, an accountant and a family member into one coherent picture.
synthesize.communication: Integrate feedback from five reviewers into one account of what the draft must address.
synthesize.systems_ops: Integrate three postmortems into one account of the recurring failure structure.

critique.software: Review this service's architecture proposal and tell me where it is weak and how it should improve.
critique.research: Review this paper's methodology section and tell me where it is weak and how it should improve.
critique.personal: Review this retirement savings plan and tell me where it is weak and how it should improve.
critique.communication: Review this fundraising letter and tell me where it is weak and how it should improve.
critique.systems_ops: Review this on-call runbook and tell me where it is weak and how it should improve.

verify.software: Standard: every public endpoint must require authentication. Establish whether this router configuration satisfies it.
verify.research: Standard: every claim must be supported by a cited source that states it. Establish whether this results section satisfies it.
verify.personal: Standard: the tenancy agreement must permit pets and subletting. Establish whether this lease satisfies it.
verify.communication: Standard: no statistic may appear without its source and date. Establish whether this press release satisfies it.
verify.systems_ops: Standard: every production service must declare CPU and memory limits. Establish whether this manifest satisfies it.

ideate.software: Propose candidate approaches for making cold starts faster. Constraint: no change to the public API.
ideate.research: Propose competing hypotheses for why the replication failed while the original succeeded.
ideate.personal: Propose candidate ways to create two uninterrupted hours a day for study. Constraint: caregiving evenings are fixed.
ideate.communication: Propose candidate framings for announcing a price increase to long-standing customers.
ideate.systems_ops: Propose candidate remediations for a database that intermittently exhausts its connection pool.

decide.software: Candidates: rewrite, strangle-fig migration, or leave as-is. Hard constraint: no downtime over 5 minutes. Priority: reduce on-call burden first, then delivery speed. Which should we choose?
decide.research: Candidates: RCT, matched cohort, or interrupted time series. Hard constraint: no randomisation is permitted. Priority: causal strength first, then time to result. Which method should we choose?
decide.personal: Candidates: three schools. Hard constraint: reachable without a car. Priority: my child's specific support needs first, then commute. Which should we choose?
decide.communication: Candidates: email, webinar, or one-to-one calls. Hard constraint: must reach all 400 customers within a week. Priority: perceived sincerity first, then effort. Which channel should we choose?
decide.systems_ops: Candidates: scale up, add a read replica, or add caching. Hard constraint: budget increase under 15%. Priority: reduce p99 latency first, then operational simplicity. Which should we choose?

plan.software: Form a strategy for migrating from a self-hosted queue to a managed one without a maintenance window.
plan.research: Form a strategy for a two-year research programme on soil carbon in temperate pasture.
plan.personal: Form a strategy for changing career from teaching into data work over the next 18 months.
plan.communication: Form a strategy for rebuilding trust with a customer base after a prolonged outage.
plan.systems_ops: Form a strategy for reaching a 15-minute recovery objective for the payments platform.

taskify.software: Here is the approved strategy for splitting the monolith's billing module. Convert it into executable work units.
taskify.research: Here is the approved research programme design. Convert it into executable work units.
taskify.personal: Here is the approved plan for the house move. Convert it into executable work units.
taskify.communication: Here is the approved communications strategy for the product launch. Convert it into executable work units.
taskify.systems_ops: Here is the approved disaster-recovery improvement plan. Convert it into executable work units.

generate.software: Specification: a retry helper with exponential backoff, jitter, a max-attempts cap, and unit tests. Produce it.
generate.research: Specification: a data-management plan section covering storage, retention, access control and sharing. Produce it.
generate.personal: Specification: a one-page moving checklist grouped by week, covering utilities, address changes and the dog. Produce it.
generate.communication: Specification: a 300-word internal announcement of a leadership change, neutral tone, no speculation. Produce it.
generate.systems_ops: Specification: an alert runbook entry with symptom, triage steps, escalation path and rollback. Produce it.
